title: lem-pc-kflat-single-tensor-representative
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with a chosen derived category D(O_Y) [def-pc-derived-category] and its fixed derived tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure]. Let A,B be O_Y-module sheaves, P an arbitrary integer-indexed cochain complex, and a:P→A[0] a K-flat resolution [def-pc-kflat-complex]. Then A[0] tensor-derived B[0] is isomorphic in D(O_Y) to Q(Tot(P tensor B[0])). No boundedness or quasi-coherence condition is assumed.

proof.text: Install the shared tensor closed structure and functorial flat resolution instances; identify acyclic-tensor K-flatness with categorical K-flatness on the homotopy quotient, using symmetry for the other factor.

Apply the proved generic source QObjTensorSingleFunctorObjIso in FlatModel. The localized augmentation and singleFunctorIsoCompQ identify Q(P) with A[0]. Compose with the inverse single-total-tensor comparison from BifunctorSingle.

theorem nonempty_kFlat_single_tensor_representative
    (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (A B : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (a : P ⟶ (HomologicalComplex.single
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (.up ℤ) 0).obj A)
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlatResolution (R := Y.sheaf) a) :
    letI : MonoidalCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) :=
      SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory Y.sheaf
    let S := DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0
    Nonempty (S.obj A ⊗ S.obj B ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P
        ((HomologicalComplex.single
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (.up ℤ) 0).obj B)
        (curriedTensor _)))
